title: SA/48/1976 of MOHD.IBRAHIM Vs LALA BABULAL JAIN AND OTHERS

paras.text:
SA No. 1210 of 2001
(Old No. 48/76)
Hon'ble P.C. Pant, J.
 None present for either of the parties.
 The appellant and respondent No. 5
are reported to have died.
 No steps taken by the legal heirs for
their substitution in place of the appellant
nor any application moved for substitution
of the legal representatives of the deceased
respondent No.5.
 The appeal stands abated. As such,
the same is dismissed as abated.
 Interim order, if any, stands vacated
automatically.
 Consign the record to the record
room.
 (P.C. Pant, J.)
Dt. 18.08.2006
HN
